chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm from Abdullah ibn Maymun from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) from his father (peace be upon him) who said:
Ali (peace be upon him) said: When a man divorces his wife, he has more right to her as long as she has not performed the ritual bath (ghusl) from the third (divorce).

key_terms.أَحَقّ بِهَا: has more right to her / is more entitled to her

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a husband to retain the right to his wife after a triple divorce?
ai.summary: In the Shia jurisprudential tradition, this hadith clarifies the precise moment when a triple divorce becomes irrevocable (ba'in), linking the finality of the bond to the wife's completion of the ritual bath (ghusl) after the third pronouncement. This ruling underscores the importance of physical purification as a marker for the expiration of the waiting period (iddah), distinguishing it from mere pronouncement. It reflects the Imami view that the husband's right of revocation (raj'a) persists until the wife has purified herself from the third divorce, ensuring the procedural integrity of the separation.
